js13kGames 2017 co-op. One player is the HACKER in an 8×8 corporate
network; the other is the NAVIGATOR at a terminal. Access codes encode
the maze (colours, walls, traps, target). The original connection is
voice — there is no game server. The A-Frame VR scene loaded
aframe.io from a CDN and cannot ride in a GifOS GIF.

This directory pins the maze / code generator (js/network/network.js,
sha256 018b19a1749a8219ef21cc26023f4e55cd8af345bd617370e4cf88bd9fa2b7ea).
The HACKER view is a canvas rewrite of that maze (no A-Frame, no
WebRTC). The NAVIGATOR terminal is the original command set (nmap,
help, top, cat, sandwich) talking to the same generator.

Invite is the room: the hacker can send a code they found so the
navigator does not have to type it. Scores live in this file, not
localStorage.
